name: Successfully search, select, and enter payment details for a train ticket

steps.name: Given User launches MakeMyTrip application
And User loads test data from Excel "test_data.xlsx"
When User closes the login popup
And User navigates to the Trains section
Then the train search dashboard should be visible
When User enters source station from Excel
And User enters destination station from Excel
And User selects a travel date from Excel
And User clicks on Search Trains button
Then the train listing results page should be loaded
When User applies the "AC" and "Available" filters
And User selects the class type from Excel
And User selects the first available train
Then the specific train details should be successfully expanded
When User enters passenger details from Excel
And User enters IRCTC username from Excel
And User fills contact details from Excel
Then the traveller should be successfully added to the itinerary
When User accepts the mandatory terms and proceeds to payment
Then the payment page should be successfully loaded
When User enters credit card details from Excel
Then the card details should be accepted for processing
